title: File4BaseLayoutSchema
description: Deterministic JSON layout schema defining view structure, parts, and objects for File4Base Flutter renderer.

table_occurrence.description: The base Table Occurrence (TO) in the relationship graph context.

width.description: Fixed canvas design width in logical pixels.

theme.description: The layout's theme: how a generated layout looks (#33). Not the application theme in Manage Themes, which colours the window.

label_stock.description: Present only on a labels layout, which is one label repeated across and down a sheet (#33).

date_order.description: Order a date is typed and shown in on this layout when its field has no date format of its own: set by a migration from the source file's locale. Absent follows the device's locale.

background_image.description: Picture drawn behind every object of the layout. Stored inline as base64 (max 2 MB) or referenced by URL.

on_layout_enter.description: Script trigger run in Browse mode when the layout is shown, unless enabled is false. Same shape as a button action with type perform_script.

enabled.description: False switches the trigger off; absent means on.

on_layout_exit.description: Script trigger run in Browse mode when another layout replaces this one, unless enabled is false. Same shape as on_layout_enter.

script_triggers.description: Every other trigger of the layout and of its objects (#26): those switched off, those of events File4Base does not run, and those set on an object. Nothing in this list runs. A trigger imported from FileMaker arrives here with enabled false and quarantined_by_migration true; File > Manage > Script Triggers enables it, which moves it into on_layout_enter or on_layout_exit.

id.description: Unique across the solution; a copied layout gets new ids.

event.description: The FileMaker event, such as OnLayoutEnter, OnRecordLoad or OnObjectSave.

script_id.description: The imported script it runs; absent when the script was not found.

object_id.description: The layout object the trigger is set on.

object.description: The FileMaker object the trigger was set on, when that object was not migrated.

parameter_problem.description: Why the parameter could not be bound to the imported fields.

file_reference.description: The FileMaker file reference of a script in another file. Such a trigger is never bound to a script of this solution.

transition.description: Effect played when the layout is shown in Browse mode.

parts.description: List of structural layout parts dividing the canvas vertically. The layout height is the sum of the part heights: the layout ends at the bottom of the footer.

break_field.description: Field identifier used for grouping if part is subsummary.

fill_color.description: Colour the part's band is filled with, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Without it the layout's background shows.

objects.description: UI elements placed on the layout canvas.

text.description: Text of labels, buttons and drawn shapes. Merge symbols {{field_name}}, {{CurrentDate}}, {{CurrentTime}}, {{CurrentUser}} and {{PageNumber}} are resolved in Browse and Preview modes.

hide_when.description: Calculation evaluated against the record shown: when it is true, Browse mode hides the object (FileMaker's Hide object when).

hide_in_find.description: Whether hide_when applies in Find mode too, as FileMaker's Apply in Find mode. Find mode currently shows every object.

tabs.description: tab_control and slide_control: the label of each panel, in order (a slide control's are empty).

default_panel.description: tab_control and slide_control: the panel in front when the layout opens. popover_button: -1, its popover (the objects on its panel 0) closed until the button is clicked.

tab_height.description: tab_control: the height of its row of tabs.

panel.description: The tab or slide control this object sits on a panel of, by id, and which panel: the object is shown only while that panel is in front.

tab_order.description: Position of a field or button in the Tab key sequence. Objects without it follow the numbered ones in reading order (top to bottom, left to right).

action.description: What a button runs when clicked in Browse mode.

step_type.description: single_step: new_record, duplicate_record, delete_record, commit_records, revert_record, go_to_record, enter_find_mode, perform_find, show_all_records, enter_preview_mode, go_to_layout, set_field, show_dialog, open_url.

params.description: Step parameters, named as in the Script Workspace: target, layout_name, field, value, title, message, url.

media.description: Picture, PDF, audio/video or file shown inside a shape (rect, rounded_rect, oval) or a media object. Stored inline as base64 (max 2 MB) or referenced by URL.

table_occurrence.description: Occurrence the field is read from. Another occurrence makes this a related field, read through relationship_id (#36).

relationship_id.description: Relationship followed to reach table_occurrence. The same two tables can be joined more than once, so the occurrence alone does not identify the join.

relationship_side.description: End read when relationship_id joins table_occurrence to itself, sent as side. Absent reads the right end; ignored for a relationship between two occurrences.

allow_browse_entry.description: False when the field cannot be typed into in Browse mode (Form and List view).

allow_find_entry.description: False when a find request cannot be typed into the field.

first_repetition.description: First repetition of a repeating field the object shows and edits.

placeholder.description: Text the control shows while it is empty.

unresolved_relationship.description: Set by a migration for a field of an occurrence no relationship joins to the layout's (FileMaker shows <Unrelated Table>): shown as unreachable until a relationship is chosen.

occurrence_path.description: Set by a migration for a field of an occurrence several relationships away from the layout's (anchor-buoy graphs): the occurrences reached in turn, the first one relationship away, the last being table_occurrence. The first related record at the end of the chain is shown. Ignored when relationship_id is set.

missing.description: Set by a migration for a field object whose field is not in the imported tables; it is shown as missing, never read from a column of the same name.

portal_config.description: Objects of type 'portal': the related records the rows show (#36).

occurrence.description: Occurrence whose records the rows show, by name. It tells apart two occurrences of the same table; relationship_side tells apart the two ends of a relationship joining an occurrence to itself.

relationship_side.description: End the rows come from when relationship_id joins occurrence to itself, sent as side. Absent shows the right end; ignored for a relationship between two occurrences.

sort.description: Row order, as the data API takes it: 'last_name,-fee_paid'. Empty uses the relationship's own sort.

filter.description: Calculation evaluated from the portal's occurrence against each related record; only the records it is true for are shown (FileMaker's Filter portal records). Empty shows them all.

filter_problem.description: Set by a migration when the source filter could not be bound; the filter is then '0' and the portal shows no record until it is set again.

occurrence_path.description: Instead of relationship_id, for an occurrence several relationships from the layout's (#26): the occurrences reached in turn, the last being occurrence. The rows are every record reached at the end; none is created through it.

chart_config.description: Objects of type 'chart': what it draws (#37).

category_field.description: Grouped charts: the field whose values are the categories. Scatter: the number field along the bottom.

field.description: Grouped charts: a summary field. Scatter: the number field up the side.

border_color.description: Line color: border of shapes and fields, color of line objects.

border_width.description: Line width in points; 0 draws no border.
